# Field notes on tidal turbines

Tidal turbines turn **slowly** because water is about 800 times denser than air. A blade moving at three metres per second carries as much energy as a gale.

## Sites

1. Pentland Firth
2. Strangford Lough
3. *Raz Blanchard*

| Site | Peak flow (m/s) |
|------|-----------------|
| Pentland Firth | 5.0 |
| Strangford Lough | 4.0 |
